_title: Tenchu: Return from Darkness (0x41560026), XDK 5849, D3D8
_why: XbSymbolDatabase does not cover XMV, so these had no names.
scripts/section_calls.py finds seven calls into the XMV section
CreateAudioStream sit at XGRA's and Future Perfect's offsets from Create;
the rest are named from the movie code at 0x0005F460..0x000602A0.
The intros go through CreateFromPackets, which is replaced here so the
host plays the file the title opened. See docs/technical/video-playback.md.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackCreate
symbols._note: 0x003A380D. From 0x0005F493 (sub_0005F460): (4 or 6, path, &handle at 0x008CF95C). Not the intros' path.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackCreateFromPackets
symbols._note: 0x003A3A3A. Create + 0x22D, as XGRA's 0x000D975A. From 0x0005F721 (sub_0005F620, the intros): (4, first 4 KB packet, context 0x008CF974, callbacks 0x0005F950 and 0x0005FA20, &handle at 0x008CF95C).

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackDestroy
symbols._note: 0x003A3D51. Create + 0x544, as XGRA and Future Perfect.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackGetStreamInfo
symbols._note: 0x003A3E35. Create + 0x628. From 0x0005F7F2 into 0x008CF9AC: width, height, and the audio count at +0xC (0x008CF9B8).

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackCreateAudioStream
symbols._note: 0x003A3EA2. Create + 0x695, as XGRA and Future Perfect; called once per audio stream GetStreamInfo reports.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackTerminate
symbols._note: 0x003A4021. Create + 0x814, one argument. Stops and releases the playback's DirectSound streams, returns its packets through the title's release callback and sets +0x74, so the next Update reports end of file: the XDK's XMVDecoder_TerminatePlayback, as far as can be told. Called from 0x0005FCBD (sub_00060260) when Start skips a movie.

symbols.name: XMVPlaybackUpdate
symbols._note: 0x003A41EC. From 0x0005FCD3 (sub_0005FC00, once a frame): (handle, level 0 of a YUY2 texture, &status at 0x008CF970, 0). Status 1 swaps the two textures.
